findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: 1ST REPEAT: Observed the handwashing sink to be obstructed with a large garbage bin. CORRECTED: Discussed with PIC and the bin was removed allowing access to the hand sink. PIC plans to instead get a smaller garbage bin so that the handwashing sink will not be blocked and can sit below the handwashing sink. Ensure that the hand sink is accessible at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [Pf]

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed that the sanitizer spray bottle (quaternary ammonium) had not been diluted, and was measuring above the concentration considered safe for food-contact surfaces (over 400ppm). CORRECTED: PIC was notified, and decided that they would stop using the spray bottle. PIC made a new sanitizer bucket from the triple sink sanitizer hose, which measured at a safe and effective concentration of 400ppm. Ensure that potentially toxic materials are used according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
findings.citation_text: 7-202.12(A) Conditions of Use. POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS shall be: (A) Used according to: (1) LAW and this Code, (2) Manufacturer's use directions included in labeling, and, for a pesticide, manufacturer's label instructions that state that use is allowed in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, (3) The conditions of certification, if certification is required, for use of the pest control materials, and (4) Additional conditions that may be established by the REGULATORY AUTHORITY. [P]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed that the dish racks have a visible accumulation of grease. PIC was notified, and will have staff clean the dish racks more frequently to prevent an accumulation of soil residues.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Observed that the triple sink sanitizer hose dispenser is leaking at the handle. PIC was notified, and will have it repaired by the next routine inspection. Ensure plumbing is maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(B) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed staff’s failure to use a barrier to shut off the faucet after washing their hands. Discussed with PIC and this behavior was corrected. Ensure that staff are aware to use a barrier to shut off the faucet after handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Inspector observed the sanitizer dispenser at the 3 part sink to be less than the amount required by code. The tube was blocked by a crystal of dried sanitizer. The dispenser was putting out liquid sanitizer at less than 100ppm of Quat. The tube at the dispenser was cleaned and the sanitizer dispenser started putting out sanitizing solution at 400ppm of Quat. The violation was corrected on site. Use test strips daily to ensure that the sanitizer dispensing equipment is dispensing properly. 

Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Inspector observed two fans attached to the wall are soiled with dust. The fans were taken down and cleaned. Maintain fans clean. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: Inspector observed the floor sink under the 3 part sink to be soiled. Clean and maintain this area clean for the next routine inspection.

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-501.110: Inspector observed purses and back packs to be stored on the shelves holing single use items and other food related items that need to be protected or kept clean.  

(A) Dressing rooms shall be used by EMPLOYEES if the EMPLOYEES regularly change their clothes in the establishment. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions.
